messages:
alex_cheng: Heads-up: seeing a ~25% token/sec drop on prod since the runtime merge landed last night (rev 0f3a2d). Queues back up, latency SLOs tripping.

sara: Ugh. Which merge? link to the PR? can you paste the graphs? :eyes:

alex_cheng: https://grafana.redwood/prod/inference/scheduler/token_rate spike at 03:12 UTC. p95 latency also climbs. small-sample flame: `coalesce_wait` is much bigger.

perf-bot: CI perf job `runtime-e2e/perf` failed on main at 2071234000 — regression +22% median token latency compared to baseline. See: CI#4821

kevin_w: Probable suspects: the new coalescer heuristic + the "regen-shim" change to kernel routing. Both landed together. Can we bisect?

jamie-r: Starting a local bisect now. Steps: `git bisect start --bad main --good v2026-05-14` then run perf harness (short run). I'll post results.

lina: Quick mitigation idea: hold the canary for the rollout and route traffic to the fallback kernel variant `kernel-v1` via rollout policy. That should avoid the regen-shim path.

jamie-r: Bisect points to 0f3a2d9 -> patch that updated scheduler coalesce window calculation and introduced a fast-path that defers batches longer when KV hit rate is below 0.6. Reproduced locally: token/sec down ~24%.

alex_cheng: Snippet from profiler (short run):
```
name           self(ms)  total(ms)  calls
coalesce_wait  4120      5120       120
batch_emit     3100      4200       118
kv_lookup      900       1500       118
```
coalesce_wait jumps after that commit.

kevin_w: That matches theory: the new heuristic overweighs kv_hitrate as a reason to wait for bigger batches, but our trace shows small-batch starvation because prefetches are delayed. Could be interaction with prefetch scheduling.

jamie-r: Reproduced with a mini-sim: toggling the threshold back to 0.45 makes token/sec and p95 latency return to baseline.

lina: Can we do a quick rollback of the heuristic change in the branch and push a patch behind a feature flag? Also prepare a canary hold rule.

alex_cheng: Rolling back the heuristic in a branch now. Will test in staging then push hotfix.

perf-bot: Noted: mark main as blocked for rollout until hotfix merges.

sara: Once the rollback is in, let's add a unit test + a microbenchmark that asserts no >10% token/sec regression for low KV hit scenarios. Also add better telemetry on `coalesce_wait` histogram by route.

kevin_w: Agree. Longer term: add a dampening factor so coalesce window doesn't swing wildly with transient kv hit noise. Also consider a fallback path that bypasses regen-shim when backlog grows.

jamie-r: Hotfix branch ready: `hotfix/coalesce-low-hitrate-rollback`. Deploying to staging.

alex_cheng: Staging perf: token/sec recovered, p95 down to baseline. Preparing PR to revert the change on main and then reintroduce behind FF with tests.

lina: I'll open a rollout hold and a postmortem stub. Add investigation tags and timeline.

sara: Thanks everyone — great catch. Can we add a short note to the runbook about watching `coalesce_wait` spikes and CI gate for perf? :white_check_mark:

jamie-r: PR opened and flagged for urgent review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/6789

alex_cheng: Leaving the thread — ping me if anything unexpected pops up.

perf-bot: AUTO: incident label `perf-regression` attached.
